Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Intent Parsing Pipeline (Chat Interpreter & IntentManager)
Content:
## Overview

The agent's intent parsing pipeline transforms player chat messages into actionable goals through a multi-stage process:

```
Chat → IChatInterpreter → ChatInterpretation → IntentManager → GoalRequest → GoalFactory → IGoal
```

This is PRINCIPLE-1 (Sprint 35+): **parsers never create goals**. The interpreter expresses semantic intent via `ChatInterpretation`; `IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest` maps it to a typed `GoalRequest`; `GoalFactory.CreateAsync` resolves the `GoalRequest.GoalName` to a concrete `IGoal`.

## IntentDraft Schema (LlmChatInterpreter)

The LLM returns a JSON object via `ParseDecision` with these fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `addressed` | string | `"yes"` \| `"maybe"` \| `"no"` — whether the player is addressing the bot |
| `intent` | string | One of 12 intent types (see below) |
| `item` | string? | Minecraft item/block ID targeted by the intent |
| `blueprint` | string? | Blueprint name for build intent |
| `count` | int? | Quantity for gather/craft/smelt/place intents |
| `x`, `y`, `z` | int? | Coordinates for navigate/place intents |
| `confidence` | float | 0.0–1.0; `LlmConfidenceThreshold` (default 0.6) gates clarification |
| `clarificationQuestion` | string? | Asked when `confidence < threshold` |
| `response` | string | In-game reply (max 50 words, empty if intent is `ignore`) |
| `nextSteps` | string? | Parsed via `ParseCommandString` for multi-step chaining (TSK-0205) |

### 12 Intent Types

| Intent | Maps To | Produces Goal? |
|--------|---------|----------------|
| `gather` | `GatherGoalRequest(item, count)` | Yes (default count 10) |
| `place` | `PlaceGoalRequest(item, count, x?, y?, z?)` | Yes (null coords = place in front, Sprint 54) |
| `craft` | `CraftGoalRequest(item, count)` | Yes (default count 1) |
| `build` | `BuildGoalRequest(blueprint, origin?)` | Yes (resolves blueprint aliases) |
| `navigate` | `NavigateGoalRequest(x, y, z)` | Yes (null coords → handled separately in ABS) |
| `smelt` | `SmeltGoalRequest(inputItem, count)` | Yes (Sprint 44 TSK-0079; separated from craft) |
| `cancel` | null | No — fast-pathed, produces no goal |
| `status` | null | No — fast-pathed, produces no goal |
| `help` | null | No — fast-pathed, produces no goal |
| `conversation` | null | No — general chat, no goal |
| `clarify` | null | No — clarification flow |
| `ignore` | null | No — silent drop |

## IntentManager.BuildGoalRequest

Located in `Agent.Planning/IntentManager.cs`. Maps `IntentDraft` to typed `GoalRequest` subclasses:

- **gather**: `GatherGoalRequest(ResolveItem(item), draft.Count ?? 10)`
- **place**: `PlaceGoalRequest(ResolveItem(item), draft.Count ?? 1, draft.X, draft.Y, draft.Z)`
- **craft**: `CraftGoalRequest(ResolveItem(item), draft.Count ?? 1)`
- **build**: `BuildGoalRequest(ResolvedBlueprint, BuildOrigin.FromNullable(x, y, z))` via `TryBuildGoal()`
- **navigate**: `NavigateGoalRequest(x, y, z)` — returns null when coords missing (secondary path)
- **smelt**: `SmeltGoalRequest(ResolveItem(item), draft.Count ?? 1)` — Sprint 44 fix for 7-sprint-old smelt→CraftItem routing bug
- **cancel/status/help**: returns null (fast-pathed)

### Alias Resolution

- `ResolveItem(item)`: checks `AliasRegistry.ItemAliases` for canonical Minecraft ID mappings (e.g., `"wool"` → `"white_wool"`). Returns item as-is if no alias exists.
- `ResolveBlueprint(blueprint)`: checks `AliasRegistry.BlueprintAliases` for common name → canonical blueprint ID mappings (e.g., `"house"` → `"small-house"`). Returns null for null input.

## GoalRequest Hierarchy (Sprint 39 P3)

Abstract base: `GoalRequest(string GoalName)` with virtual `Parameters` dictionary for backward-compat with `GoalFactory.CreateAsync`.

| Subclass | GoalName Pattern | Parameters |
|----------|-----------------|------------|
| `GatherGoalRequest` | `GatherItem:{Item}` | `{ count }` |
| `CraftGoalRequest` | `CraftItem:{Item}` | `{ count }` |
| `BuildGoalRequest` | `Build:{Blueprint}` | `{ originX, originY, originZ }` or null |
| `NavigateGoalRequest` | `MoveTo` | `{ x, y, z }` |
| `SmeltGoalRequest` | `SmeltItem:{InputItem}` | `{ count }` |
| `PlaceGoalRequest` | `PlaceBlock:{Item}` | `{ count, x?, y?, z? }` |

## IntentManager.ParseCommandString

Parses simple command strings from `IntentDraft.NextSteps` for multi-step chaining (TSK-0205). Regex-driven patterns:

| Pattern | Maps To |
|---------|---------|
| `craft N item` / `craft item` | `CraftGoalRequest(item, count)` |
| `gather/mine/get N item` / `gather/mine/get item` | `GatherGoalRequest(item, count ?? 10)` |
| `build blueprint` / `build a blueprint` | `BuildGoalRequest(blueprint, null)` |
| `place N item` / `place item at X Y Z` / `place item in front` | `PlaceGoalRequest(item, count, x?, y?, z?)` |
| `move/go/navigate/walk to X Y Z` | `NavigateGoalRequest(x, y, z)` |
| `smelt N item` / `smelt item` | `SmeltGoalRequest(item, count)` |

Returns null for unrecognized commands.
